dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You know, there are so many different kinds of jobs out there...

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: That's true, but I must become a Lightkeeper no matter what.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: I have to keep up, you see. My good friend is already a Lightkeeper, and my brother is probably about to become one too.

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: Although I don't really have any combat skills to speak of... Ugh, Dragana, that's no excuse! No, you can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Dragana
dialogues.text: I must become someone who's really good at both sewing and battle by the time the next selection comes around!
